senses.gloss:
कुथ् कुथ्, i. 4, Par. To stink.
 कुथित, Fetid, Suśr. 2, 115, 3.
 --Causal, कोथय, To cause to putrefy, Suśr. 1, 344, 4.
 --With the prep. प्र प्र, To begin stinking, to turn putrid, प्रकुथित, Suśr. 1, 344, 5.

कुथ कुथ,
 I. m., and f. था, and n. A painted woollen blanket, MBh. 2, 1894.
 II. m. A kind of grass, Poa cynosuroides, Rām. 2, 30, 14 (but 2, 30, 16 Gorr. reads कुश, ).
